verdict.rationale: Installed plugins let the agent work over the user's own data and produce AI output from it. Examples include the Slack plugin summarizing channels and drafting replies, Codex Security scanning code to confirm vulnerability findings, Google Drive access across Docs and Sheets, and Notion research and knowledge capture. Each of these is documented only in one-line descriptions. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how insights or suggestions are generated and surfaced, no dedicated proactive insights or analytics feature, and no independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
